Module com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku
Package com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.controller

Class GameController

java.lang.Object
com.example.miniproyecto_sudoku.controller.GameController
public class GameController extends Object
Controller responsible for managing the Sudoku game view and its interactions. Handles board generation, user input, hints, undo actions, session management, and game validation.

      private void buildBoard()

    • highlightSelectedCell

      private void highlightSelectedCell(int row, int col)

      col - column of the selected cell.

    • processInput

      private void processInput(int row, int col, int value)
      Processes a value entered by the user into a cell. Updates the board, validates the move, and changes the cell style.
      Parameters:
      row - row of the selected cell.
      col - column of the selected cell.
      value - value entered by the user.

    • processClear

      private void processClear(int row, int col)

      row - row of the selected cell.
      col - column of the selected cell.

    • checkGameComplete

      private void checkGameComplete()
      Checks whether the Sudoku board has been completed successfully. If completed, clears the current session and loads the win scene.
